disclaimer: Synthetic policy for dry-run evaluation only. Not a credit policy and not a lending decision system.

behavior.approve_only_if: label is approve/low_risk, confidence >= threshold_approve, and no deterministic review flags are present
behavior.review_if: confidence is below threshold_approve, label is ambiguous, evidence is missing, or deterministic review flags are present
behavior.reject_if: label is reject/high_risk and confidence >= threshold_approve
